app.name: Truvel
app.tagline: Every city has places the map doesn't know.

nav.add: Add a place, photos or a live report

add.newPlaceHint: Somewhere the app doesn't know yet
add.media: Photos or a video of a place
add.mediaHint: Add to a place that is already here
add.pulseHint: On-site only, within 2 hours of checking in
add.fromElsewhere: Adding from elsewhere: stays Unverified until 2 people check in
add.duplicateSub: Near your pin, with similar names:
add.rulesTrespass: No private property, and no trespassing to get a photo.
add.rulesHomes: No homes, and no one's gate or front door.
add.rulesFaces: Strangers' faces should not be the subject of the photo.
add.rulesStunts: No stunts at edges. Nothing here rewards a dangerous photo.
add.captionRequired: A caption is required — it is the alt text.

deck.endBody: Widen the radius, or go see one you saved?
deck.locationFallback: Showing places near the centre of {{city}} — location is switched off, so distances are from there.

watch.followingEmpty: Follow creators from any video to see them here.
watch.empty: Be the first to post a video of a place near you.

explore.searchPlaces: Search a city, area or place

place.addName: Add the name in your language
place.unverifiedBody: Two people need to check in here before this place counts.
place.shareTrip: Ask a friend to check on me
place.fragileLocked: The directions and the exact pin open once you save this place and agree to treat it carefully.

checkin.poorAccuracy: Your phone isn't sure where you are (±{{metres}} m). Step into open sky and try again.
checkin.tooFar: You're {{distance}} away. Check in when you get there.
checkin.alreadyToday: You already checked in here today.
checkin.kadamEarned: +{{kadam}} kadam for your first visit here.
checkin.placeVerified: That is two visitors — this place is now verified.
checkin.flagged: Flagged for review. This check-in came too soon after one a long way away, so it earns no kadam.
checkin.simulated: Simulated location. This visit is excluded from metrics, attribution and earnings.

pulse.freshnessNote: Reports show as Live for 6 hours, Recent for 48, then they go.
pulse.needVisit: Only people who checked in here in the last 2 hours can report.

you.kadamNote: Kadam measure how much you've helped people explore. They can't be cashed yet.
you.noStamps: Your first stamp is one visit away.
you.noSavedBody: Swipe right on the deck to keep a place for later.

studio.bannerBody: No real money is paid in this version.
studio.projection: What your work would be worth. You are not a Partner yet, so a real month would pay nothing.
studio.emptyBody: Your first place or video starts your Studio.

settings.title: Languages & cities
settings.languageNote: Place names already appear in all 22 languages wherever OpenStreetMap, Wikidata or visitors have them. The app's own words switch language only after a native speaker has checked them.
settings.privacyNote: We never store where you are. A check-in sends one position reading, the server keeps only how far away you were and how accurate it was, and the coordinates are thrown away.

auth.displayName: Your name (shown on what you post)
auth.licence: You keep ownership of your photos and videos. By posting, you let Truvel show them in the app with your name on them.
